description: This file defines the NoteRepository interface, outlining various asynchronous and synchronous operations for managing notes, including CRUD operations, synchronization, and retrieval methods with filtering options.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: Interface for managing notes, including CRUD, synchronization, and retrieval operations with filtering options.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Asynchronously inserts a note into the repository, optionally syncing the change.

methods.name: updateNotes
methods.description: Updates one or more notes asynchronously, with optional synchronization.

methods.name: moveNotesToBin
methods.description: Moves specified notes to the trash/bin asynchronously, with optional sync.

methods.name: restoreNotes
methods.description: Restores specified notes from the trash/bin.

methods.name: deleteNotes
methods.description: Deletes specified notes asynchronously, with optional sync.

methods.name: discardEmptyNotes
methods.description: Removes all empty notes and returns whether any were discarded.

methods.name: permanentlyDeleteNotesInBin
methods.description: Permanently deletes all notes in the trash/bin.

methods.name: syncNotes
methods.description: Synchronizes notes with the cloud or remote storage, returning a result object.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Returns a flow emitting the note with the specified ID.

methods.name: getDeleted
methods.description: Returns a flow emitting a list of deleted notes, optionally sorted.

methods.name: getArchived
methods.description: Returns a flow emitting a list of archived notes, optionally sorted.

methods.name: getNonDeleted
methods.description: Returns a flow emitting a list of non-deleted notes, optionally sorted.

methods.name: getNonDeletedOrArchived
methods.description: Returns a flow emitting a list of notes that are either non-deleted or archived.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a flow emitting all notes, optionally sorted.

methods.name: getByNotebook
methods.description: Returns notes belonging to a specific notebook, optionally sorted.

methods.name: getNonRemoteNotes
methods.description: Returns notes not synchronized with a specific cloud provider.

methods.name: getNotesWithoutNotebook
methods.description: Returns notes that are not assigned to any notebook.

methods.name: getNotesByCloudService
methods.description: Retrieves notes associated with a specific cloud service, returning a map of IdMappings to Notes.

methods.name: deleteIdMappingsForCloudService
methods.description: Deletes ID mappings for notes associated with a specific cloud service.
